def find_dissimilar(tup1, tup2):
    """
    Return all elements from both tuples that are not present in the other tuple.
    
    Example:
        find_dissimilar((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10)) -> (3, 6, 7, 10)
    """
    set1 = set(tup1)
    set2 = set(tup2)

    # Elements only in tup1 or only in tup2
    dissimilar_set = (set1 - set2) | (set2 - set1)

    return tuple(sorted(dissimilar_set))


# Example usage and assertion
if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert find_dissimilar((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10)) == (3, 6, 7, 10)

def find_dissimilar(tup1, tup2):
    """
    Return all elements from both tuples that are not present in the other tuple.
    
    Example:
        find_dissimilar((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10)) -> (3, 6, 7, 10)
    """
    set1 = set(tup1)
    set2 = set(tup2)

    # Elements only in tup1 or only in tup2
    dissimilar_set = (set1 - set2) | (set2 - set1)

    return tuple(sorted(dissimilar_set))


# Example usage and assertion
assert find_dissimilar((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10)) == (3, 6, 7, 10)
